entities.name: Query RibBA-like protein
observations: 404-aa sequence has PF00926 DHBP_synthase domain at residues 13–204 and PF00925 GTP_cyclohydro2 domain at residues 217–380.

Best reviewed homolog O66679 (Aquifex aeolicus RibBA) has 57.4% identity and 99.5% query coverage; annotations support 3,4-dihydroxy-2-butanone 4-phosphate synthase and GTP cyclohydrolase II activities.

entities.name: Ribulose-5-P cleavage
observations: RibBA homolog reaction: D-ribulose 5-phosphate → (2S)-2-hydroxy-3-oxobutyl phosphate (also called 3,4-dihydroxy-2-butanone 4-phosphate) + formate + H+; Rhea RHEA:18457.

entities.name: GTP cyclohydrolase II
observations: RibBA homolog reaction: GTP + 4 H2O → 2,5-diamino-6-hydroxy-4-(5-phosphoribosylamino)-pyrimidine + formate + 2 phosphate + 3 H+; Rhea RHEA:23704.

entities.name: Riboflavin biosynthesis
observations: RibBA homolog annotations place these two activities in riboflavin biosynthesis: formation of the DHBP branch intermediate from D-ribulose 5-phosphate and the initial GTP-derived pyrimidine branch intermediate.
